simple.meaning: מִפְלֶצֶת (miphletseth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a terror , i.e. an idol.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִפְלֶצֶת (H4656) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Kings 15:13, with occurrences in 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִפְלֶצֶת (H4656) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִפְלֶצֶת (H4656) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִפְלֶצֶת (miphletseth) / H4656 is traced through 1 Kings 15:13, 2 Chronicles 15:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4656. miphletseth מִפְלֶ֫צֶת noun feminine horrid thing (thing to shudder at ); — מ ׳עָֽשְׂתָה לַאֲשֵׁרָה 1Kin 15:13 (of some abominable object of idolatry, not precisely known), so suffix מִפְלַצְתָּהּ 15:13 2Chr 15:16 (twice in verse).
